kv_cache_dtype: auto (bf16), window-bounded: the 40 sliding-window visits keep their last 1,024 tokens
serving_image: ghcr.io/enntity/atlas-sparkinkling:717bd225a5d6 (the 0.5.1 release candidate, built on this Spark), via ./start.sh
scheduler: SparkInkling default profile: max-num-seqs 8, gpu-memory-utilization 0.80, prefill chunks 8192 (one chunk a scheduler tick while others decode), CUDA graphs, programmatic dependent launch, CUTLASS BF16 prefill projections (ATLAS_BF16_GEMM_CUTLASS=1), prefix caching with conv-state snapshots (--enable-prefix-caching, --ssm-cache-slots=264) and branch checkpoints (ATLAS_GLM_PC_BRANCH=1, ATLAS_GLM_PC_BRANCH_MIN=512), --request-timeout=3600, --tool-max-tokens=32768, LoopCD off
competing_traffic: none (the voice engines suspended through LLooM for the window)
quantisation: Spark: calibrated GPTQ NVFP4 attention, lm_head and L20-23 experts over the shipped checkpoint, for decode and verify rows (row-invariant tensor-core projections, ATLAS_SKINNY_MMA=1); prefill reads the checkpoint's own tensors, its experts' inputs quantized as its hf_quant_config.json requires (W4A4 / W8A8)
drafter: DFlash2 (incoai/Inkling-2-Mini-DFlash2 @ 4f9088ea66c2), greedy drafts: 7 with one live request, 3 each with two, plain decode from three (ATLAS_DFLASH_BATCH_DEPTH=1:7,2:3,1000000:0); verifies stop where the drafter is unsure (ATLAS_DFLASH_CONF_WIDTH=1), drafts go off for a sequence whose steps stop paying (ATLAS_DFLASH_ADAPTIVE=1, threshold 2.0, the engine's accepted a block) in place of the engine throughput gate (ATLAS_MTP_GATE_FORCE=1)
